description: This file defines the 'Reports' class for the vtiger CRM system. It manages report folders, report modules, report creation, editing, and data retrieval, including configuration of filters, columns, and sorting options. It interacts with database tables related to reports and their components, providing functionalities for report management within the application.

classes.name: Reports
classes.description: This class manages report folders, module associations, report creation and retrieval, filters, sorting, and report data computations within the vtiger CRM platform.

methods.name: Reports
methods.description: Constructor to initialize report object, fetch report info if reportid is provided, and check user permissions.

methods.name: updateModuleList
methods.description: Updates the list of modules and blocks associated with the report for column selection.

methods.name: initListOfModules
methods.description: Initializes the list of all active modules and their blocks for report building.

methods.name: sgetRptFldr
methods.description: Retrieves report folders, optionally filtered by mode (active/inactive).

methods.name: sgetRptsforFldr
methods.description: Fetches reports within a specific folder.

methods.name: sgetJsRptFldr
methods.description: Generates JavaScript array for expand/collapse functionality of report folders.

methods.name: getPriModuleColumnsList
methods.description: Retrieves and sets the list of columns for the primary module of the report.

methods.name: getSecModuleColumnsList
methods.description: Retrieves and sets the list of columns for secondary modules involved in the report.

methods.name: getBlockFieldList
methods.description: Aggregates fields from given blocks for module columns.

methods.name: getModuleFieldList
methods.description: Fetches all fields for a specific module's blocks.

methods.name: getColumnsListbyBlock
methods.description: Retrieves fields within a specific block of a module for report column selection.

methods.name: getSelectedStandardCriteria
methods.description: Fetches and sets the date filter criteria for a report.

methods.name: getSelectedStdFilterCriteria
methods.description: Generates HTML options for standard date filter choices.

methods.name: getStdCriteriaByModule
methods.description: Retrieves applicable fields for standard filtering for a specified module.

methods.name: getCriteriaJS
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for dynamic date range selection in filters.

methods.name: getEscapedColumns
methods.description: Prepares column data for query building based on selected fields.

methods.name: getaccesfield
methods.description: Gets fields accessible to the current user for a module.

methods.name: getSelctedSortingColumns
methods.description: Retrieves and sets user-selected sorting columns and order for reports.

methods.name: getSelectedColumnsList
methods.description: Retrieves and generates HTML for columns selected in a report.

methods.name: getAdvancedFilterList
methods.description: Fetches and structures advanced filter criteria for reporting.

methods.name: sgetRptFldrSaveReport
methods.description: Generates HTML options for report folder selection during report saving.

methods.name: sgetColumntoTotal
methods.description: Retrieves options for columns that can be summed or averaged for report totals.

methods.name: sgetColumntoTotalSelected
methods.description: Retrieves user-selected columns for report totals and formatting.

methods.name: sgetColumnstoTotalHTML
methods.description: Creates HTML for columns available for total calculations with checkboxes.

methods.name: getAdvCriteriaHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML select options for advanced filter criteria based on provided selection.

methods.name: getColumnstoTotalHTML
methods.description: Creates HTML options for columns that can be summed or averaged for report totals, including checkboxes for different aggregation types.
